dialogue.text: Hi! Little Haru and I wanted to say thank you for the hospitable stay. I hope we can be useful here.
Oh! Apologies, My name is An Nomura and I think you know who this is.
You know, those windows should be boarded up by now.
Well, most buildings here can handle the violent shakes. However, this safehouse is old. We’re lucky those windows haven’t broken.
Boarding up the windows and securing the furniture minimizes dangers and injuries if there was another earthquake again.
Remember that for the next time before it’s too late.
Can never be too safe! Especially when you have a little guy with you.
Ah! He's starting to wake up...
Ah! Quick, go board up those windows. I’ll have a surprise for you when you get back.
